evidence.claim: Customer reported: Customer C13171 message: 'I never made this $55.68 purchase. Please check my card.' Refers to 3558054.
Customer C13171 explicitly reported and denied authorizing transaction 3558054 ($55.68) on card C13171-K2, stating 'I never made this $55.68 purchase. Please check my card.'

Flagged transaction 3558054 is part of a rapid burst of three online product C transactions on card C13171-K2 within 20 minutes on 2016-12-19 totaling $166.97, preceded by transaction 3557979 ($55.60 at 21:48:32) and transaction 3557987 ($55.69 at 21:50:54), all sharing device D008431 and email domain hotmail.com.

Transaction 3558054 has no recurring pattern in the cardholder baseline and used device D008431, which is new for holder C13171-K2|NA|170 whose prior legitimate transactions only utilized devices D000019 and D008387.

Card C13171-K2 has 18 confirmed fraud closed cases, including CC-5010, CC-4485, CC-4163, and CC-3728, where customer reports of unrecognized online transactions were confirmed as card-not-present fraud.

Device D008431 is a generic browser profile ('unknown | unknown | chrome 66.0 | unknown') associated with 175 cards all-time and 0 closed fraud cases, confirming the compromise is localized to card C13171-K2 rather than a cross-card device ring.

case.summary: Customer C13171 alerted the bank to an unauthorized $55.68 online transaction on card C13171-K2. Graph analysis confirmed that this transaction was part of an anomalous 20-minute burst of three nearly identical charges on 2016-12-19 totaling $166.97, all conducted via device D008431. Device D008431 was newly observed on this cardholder baseline and the charges do not match any recurring billing history. Based on the customer denial corroborated by the card-not-present burst pattern, the episode was determined to be fraudulent, resulting in card blockage and case creation.
